description: Source code for the Laminas\Diactoros\UploadedFile class implementing file upload handling, including error management, file movement, and stream access.

classes.name: UploadedFile
classes.description: Class representing an uploaded file, providing methods to access file data, move the file, and handle upload errors.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an UploadedFile instance with stream or filename, size, error status, and optional client filename and media type.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Returns a StreamInterface for reading the uploaded file's data, throws exception if upload failed or already moved.

methods.name: moveTo
methods.description: Moves the uploaded file to a specified target path, handling different server API environments and errors.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the uploaded file in bytes, or null if unknown.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Returns the upload error status code.

methods.name: getClientFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename sent by the client.

methods.name: getClientMediaType
methods.description: Returns the media type sent by the client.

methods.name: writeFile
methods.description: Private method to write the stream data to a specified file path.
